channel_model.description: SRP = D2-pipeline prior SRP, Sionna RT 2.1 ray-traced channels (code/srp_build.py -> pool read by code/dmimo.py, sha 4969fb3ccfba2865/3ea97198c47b43b5): the room of prior SRB (scene `box`, metal walls as shipped, 28 GHz, PathSolver depth 1, 1e8 samples, ONE fixed BS) with ONE UE moving along a lawn-mower route (576 rows x 600 snapshots, 1.5 cm apart, no position twice; UE array aligned with the direction of travel), Sionna PlanarArray ULAs (BS Nr, UE 4), isotropic V pol, half-wavelength, Paths.cfr at the carrier, per-pair path powers normalised, uplink by reciprocity, ensemble-normalised E||H||^2 = Nr Nt; FIXED pool split BY TIME (test = the last 15 % of the route); the receiver treats every block on its own
